data.name: Antipas
data.gender_notes: Antipas is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Antipas is recorded in name-lists as “Opponent of God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Antipas expresses “Opponent of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Antipas total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: ענטיפס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עובד-פסח, פסח-עבד, עבד-פסח, פרשן בספר יהושע, 6:28, כאחד מ-7 שבעים קדושי-יהוה, שבשורות-פסח, יהוה-עבד-פסח.

in_greek.name: Ἀντίπαス
in_greek.meaning: ὑπηρέτης τοῦ πάσχα, πάσχα ὑπηρέτης, δούλος τοῦ πάσχα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὑπηρέτης τοῦ πάσχα, πάσχα ὑπηρέτης, δούλος τοῦ πάσχα, ὡς ἕνας ἀπό τῶν ἑβδομήκοντα ἱερέων τοῦ Θεοῦ, στοιχειοθετημένος ἐν τοῖς Ἀποστολικοῖς-Πασχα, ὁ Κύριος, δούλος τοῦ πάσχα.

in_latin.name: Antipas
in_latin.meaning: minister Paschae, paschalis minister, servus Paschae
in_latin.long_meaning: Minister Paschae, paschalis minister, servus Paschae, ut unus e septuaginta sanctis Dei, in Apostolorum-Pascha, Domini, servus Paschae.

pronunciation.biblical: Ancient Hebrew: ʿntypʿs; Ancient Greek: Ἀντίπασ
